title: Google Vids: Free AI Avatar of You, No Camera 🎬
description:
Google Vids now gives everyone with a personal Google account a free AI avatar of themselves. Open vids.new on a computer, scan the QR code to capture your likeness, then type what you want to say and your avatar says it, scene after scene. The avatar is linked to your Google Account and can only be your own likeness.

Would you let an AI version of you make your videos? Tell us in the comments!

🔔 Follow AI Daily Drop for a new AI trick every Wednesday.

Source: Google, "Anyone can create a personal avatar of themselves in Google Vids, at no cost." (November 17, 2026); The Mobile Indian (November 18, 2026)
